---
title: "Working with Text"
---

We have used the stringr package in R with the str_detect() function. stringr is a package we can use for pattern matching, but also character manipulation. It is worth understanding a little about how this character manipulation works because it gives you much greater control over the ways you can label and annotate your plots.

There are two main ways we'll work with text, which focuses on tabular data:

-   Where we provide text for our plots directly, usually for titles and for annotations.
-   Where we ask R to draw labels from our data directly on to a plot.

::: callout-note
If you have actual text data you want to analyse, I recommend looking at the package [Tidytext](https://www.tidytextmining.com/), but this is out of the scope of this course.
:::

The first case is quite straightforward. We'll see in the next section that you just provide the titles and annotations as text within quotation marks.
